definition: The boundary is expressed as a distance above or below a reference.
scopenote: The value form of vertical-definition-type:relative-height-description. The definition type says how a vertical boundary is defined; the value type says how its value is recorded.

definition: The boundary is expressed as an absolute height in a vertical CRS or datum.
scopenote: The value form of vertical-definition-type:absolute-height-description. The definition type says how a vertical boundary is defined; the value type says how its value is recorded.

definition: The boundary is defined by reference to an identified surface, plane, or geometry.
scopenote: The value form of vertical-definition-type:geometry-boundary-reference and building-referenced-boundary. The definition type says how a vertical boundary is defined; the value type says how its value is recorded.

definition: The boundary is retained as a legal or jurisdictional expression that has not been reduced to a numeric value or geometry.
scopenote: The value form of vertical-definition-type:jurisdictional-boundary-rule while the rule has not been reduced to a value or geometry. The definition type says how a vertical boundary is defined; the value type says how its value is recorded.
